title: Very Cute but the material is not very good
text: Very Cute but the material is not very good. My kitchen accessorizes are all aqua/mint colored and I was so excited when I found these in that color. Love the design but the material feels cheap and its is so see through, super sheer I wanted a little bit of privacy as my kitchen faces a busy street and the windows are not very high. I would recommend to someone who does not mind it being see through or has high windows.
